title: 雨夜咖啡馆的时间循环

storyBible.worldAnchor: A cozy rainy night in a small town coffee shop, soft warm lighting, gentle rain on the window, familiar vintage interior.

characters.name: Liu
characters.anchorPrompt: Liu, a mid-20s adult, wearing a dark hoodie, standing in the rain-soaked coffee shop, neutral expression.

props.name: Coffee Cup
props.anchorPrompt: Small ceramic coffee cup, black glaze, round body, small handle, slight steam rising, resting on a wooden table.

locations.name: Rainy Night Coffee Shop
locations.anchorPrompt: Inside a dim, warmly lit coffee shop, wooden furnishings, rain pattering on the window, soft ambient glow.

eventChain: Scene 1: Liu enters the coffee shop on a rainy night and senses that tonight’s choice will change everyone’s fate.
Scene 2: Liu faces a choice: investigate the anomaly or protect a nearby companion.
Scene 3: Liu chooses to investigate and uncovers a repeatable pattern behind the events.
Scene 4: Liu chooses to protect the companion, missing the first clue but gaining deeper trust.
Scene 5: Liu breaks the loop and walks toward a new dawn holding the truth.
Scene 6: Liu keeps the secret, maintaining the status quo while knowing what to do next time.
